# PRV-AI-01

**Where personal data trains, fine-tunes or is remembered by a model, is the lawful basis recorded, and can one person's data be taken out again?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Privacy by design](privacy.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | AI: Personal data and models |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Applies when | A data set with personal true is used_for_ai training, fine-tuning or memory. |
| Reads | `data.personal`, `data.used_for_ai`, `decisions` |

## Why it matters

Data a model has learnt from is hard to remove. Training or memory on personal data needs a recorded basis and a way to honour erasure, such as retraining, unlearning, or keeping the data out of the weights and in a store that can be purged.

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 6, lawfulness of processing. (`gdpr-6`)
- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 17, right to erasure. (`gdpr-17`)
- European Data Protection Board, Opinion 28/2024 on certain data protection aspects related to the processing of personal data in the context of AI models (2024). (`edpb-ai`)
